name: Leaderboard List
description: Browse a unified, paginated live index of AREDL, Global Demonlist Classic, and Pointercrate in-game. / Jelajahi daftar live terpadu AREDL, Global Demonlist Classic, dan Pointercrate di dalam game.

language.name: Language / Bahasa
language.description: Choose the interface language. / Pilih bahasa antarmuka.

show-floating-button.name: Floating Extreme button
show-floating-button.description: Show the leaderboard shortcut on the main menu. / Tampilkan pintasan leaderboard di menu utama.

floating-size.name: Floating button size / Ukuran tombol
floating-size.description: Choose the shortcut size, then drag it anywhere on the main menu. / Pilih ukuran lalu geser tombol ke posisi yang diinginkan.

show-floating-label.name: Floating button caption / Label tombol
show-floating-label.description: Show the EXTREME caption below the shortcut. / Tampilkan tulisan EXTREME di bawah tombol.

show-thumbnails.name: Level thumbnails / Thumbnail level
show-thumbnails.description: Show a small art tile for each level. / Tampilkan gambar kecil tiap level.

video-previews.name: Video thumbnails / Thumbnail video
video-previews.description: Fetch video covers only when list data provides a valid YouTube link (extra network use). / Unduh sampul video jika tersedia (memakai data tambahan).

reduce-motion.name: Reduce motion / Kurangi animasi
reduce-motion.description: Disable the emblem glow and floating-button pulse. / Matikan cahaya logo dan animasi tombol.

panel-theme.name: Panel style / Gaya panel
panel-theme.description: GD blue or the previous midnight design. Reopen the list to apply. / Biru GD atau desain gelap sebelumnya. Buka ulang daftar untuk menerapkan.

dim-background.name: Darken behind popup / Gelapkan belakang
dim-background.description: Darken only the game behind the panel, not the panel itself. / Gelapkan hanya game di belakang panel.

remember-tab.name: Remember last tab / Ingat tab terakhir
remember-tab.description: Reopen the list on the last selected source tab. / Buka daftar pada tab sumber yang terakhir dipilih.

show-source-marks.name: Show source marks / Tampilkan penanda sumber
show-source-marks.description: Display A, C, P source marks on each level row. / Tampilkan penanda A, C, P di setiap level.

popup-size.name: Leaderboard panel size / Ukuran panel
popup-size.description: Compact fits small Android screens. Reopen the leaderboard to apply. / Ringkas cocok untuk layar Android kecil. Buka ulang panel untuk menerapkan.
